notes: Draft configuration: Full course including both northern chicane branches and southeastern hairpin. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3500.1 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

source.name: Mapzen Terrain Tiles
attribution: Global elevation data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey and NOAA.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 79 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

supersedes.reason: The original border rings cross or touch and mix northern chicane alternatives. Complete source-aligned image measurements replace that pair while retaining the original full trace and timing.

measurement.note: Sparse approximate image measurements of the retained full source course through both northern chicane branches and the southeastern hairpin. Native and rectified reads plus six full-resolution boundary overlays were inspected. Painted/curb road limits are followed at shared paving; branch openings are interpolated virtual joins. Bridge-obscured station920 is not measured: sections900..930 interpolate between visible endpoints over approximately90m. Other sections also interpolate between sparse anchors. Capture date and absolute georeferencing accuracy are unknown. This draft source configuration and these limits are not an operator-confirmed or surveyed track.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed directly from complete, sparse image measurements on the existing trace cross-sections. All intervals interpolate between image anchors; they are not automatic detections or a continuous edge survey. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. Isolated missing pixels inside the road are not filled or used as boundary evidence. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. These borders have not been formally verified.
